outcomes.name: Below 4.3%
outcomes.description: This outcome resolves to Yes if the one-decimal BLS CPI year-over-year value for May 2026 is below 4.3%.

outcomes.name: Exactly 4.3%
outcomes.description: This outcome resolves to Yes if the one-decimal BLS CPI year-over-year value for May 2026 is exactly 4.3%.

outcomes.name: Above 4.3%
outcomes.description: This outcome resolves to Yes if the one-decimal BLS CPI year-over-year value for May 2026 is above 4.3%.

outcomes.name: June Fed rate change
outcomes.description: The market resolves to Change if the upper bound of the target federal funds rate range in the FOMC statement for the June 16-17, 2026 meeting differs from the prior FOMC statement. Otherwise it resolves to No Change.

questions.name: May CPI year-over-year
questions.description: The question resolves by assigning Yes to exactly one of Below 4.3%, Exactly 4.3%, or Above 4.3% based on the BLS Consumer Price Index news release for May 2026.
